entries.title: Website updated
notes: The latest improvements and fixes are now available.

entries.title: Download HMC Uploader directly
notes: Get the Windows, Mac Apple Silicon or Mac Intel installer directly from Downloads, without opening a GitHub release page.

entries.title: Website updated
notes: The latest improvements and fixes are now available.

entries.title: Guild reports, on the website
notes: Read Forever Digest, Night Watch and API Watch reports in a member-only archive, with direct links from Discord.

entries.title: Updates, all in one place
notes: The changelog now adds website, HMC Uploader and addon updates automatically after they are delivered.

entries.title: Dungeon & raid loot
notes: Browse boss loot with item icons, stat previews and boss portraits, straight from the Atlas.

entries.title: A richer Atlas, a clearer launch plan
notes: Explore Azeroth in 2D or 3D, with dungeon entrances, transport routes and flight connections.
Launch plans now show race, specialization and role icons. Spacing and mobile layouts are easier to read across the site.

entries.title: Your place in Azeroth
notes: Character positions are shared with signed-in guild members on the 2D and 3D Atlas.
The /hmc window now brings together weekly boards, crafters and member sheets, including quests you share with guildmates.

entries.title: More connected, in and out of game
notes: HMC Uploader brings the website's guild data into WoW and uploads character portraits taken with /hmc portrait.
Missing upload keys now show a clearer message to help you connect your account.

entries.title: Get ready for launch
notes: Plan your character for Forever: choose a race, class, specializations and professions, and see what the guild is bringing.
